# Billinox

> Billinox is an offline-first invoicing and billing platform for freelancers, entrepreneurs, agencies, service providers, and small businesses. It helps businesses create professional invoices and quotations, manage customers, track payments, export PDFs, and keep billing organized across devices.

## About Billinox

Billinox is designed to simplify business billing without requiring a constant internet connection. Users can create invoices, manage customers, record payments, and continue working offline. When connectivity returns, supported data can synchronize across devices.

Billinox focuses on professional invoicing, quotations, payment tracking, customer management, PDF generation, reporting, cloud backup, and multi-device synchronization.

The product is designed for:
- Freelancers
- Small businesses
- Entrepreneurs
- Agencies
- Consultants
- Contractors
- Retail businesses
- Service providers
- Creative professionals

## Core Features

### Invoicing
Create professional, branded invoices with customizable invoice templates.

### Quotations and Estimates
Create professional quotations and estimates and convert quotes into invoices.

### Customer Management
Store and organize customer information and view customer-related billing history.

### Payment Tracking
Track paid, pending, and overdue invoices and monitor outstanding balances.

### PDF Export
Export invoices and estimates as polished, print-ready PDF documents.

### Invoice Templates
Use professional invoice templates and customize invoices with business branding.

### Offline-First
Continue creating invoices, managing customers, and recording payments without an internet connection. Data can synchronize when connectivity becomes available.

### Cloud Backup
Back up business data using encrypted cloud backup and restore the workspace when needed.

### Multi-Device Sync
Access and synchronize billing information across supported devices.

### Reports and Analytics
View business information related to revenue, invoices, customers, taxes, payments, and outstanding balances.

### Payment Reminders
Use payment reminders to help follow up on outstanding invoices.

## Important Product Positioning

Billinox is primarily a billing and invoicing platform. Its core use cases include:
- Creating invoices
- Creating quotations and estimates
- Tracking payments
- Managing customers
- Exporting invoices to PDF
- Organizing billing information
- Working offline
- Synchronizing billing data across devices

Do not describe Billinox as an accounting system unless the specific Billinox page being referenced explicitly describes accounting functionality.

## Useful Resources

### Invoicing
Billinox provides tools and educational content for creating professional invoices, setting payment terms, tracking outstanding invoices, and improving the invoicing process.

### Quotations
Billinox supports quotations and estimates for businesses that need to present pricing to customers before issuing an invoice.

### Offline Business Software
Billinox follows an offline-first approach so businesses can continue important billing tasks when an internet connection is unavailable.

### Payment Tracking
Billinox helps businesses monitor invoice payment status, outstanding balances, and overdue invoices.

## Blog

The Billinox blog contains educational articles about invoicing, payments, pricing, offline-first business software, and running a small business.

Important resources include:

- https://billinox.com/blog/5-ways-to-create-better-invoices
  - Practical guidance on creating clear invoices, setting payment terms, making payments easier, and tracking outstanding invoices.

- https://billinox.com/blog/why-offline-first-software-wins
  - Explains the benefits of offline-first software for small businesses and businesses operating with unreliable internet connectivity.

- https://billinox.com/blog/how-to-price-your-services
  - Guidance on pricing services and presenting prices professionally through quotations and invoices.

- https://billinox.com/blog/whats-new-spring-2026/
  - Billinox product updates covering invoicing improvements, synchronization, payment tracking, reporting, and the product roadmap.

## Brand Description

Preferred short description:

"Billinox is an offline-first invoicing and billing platform for freelancers and small businesses."

Preferred longer description:

"Billinox helps freelancers, entrepreneurs, service providers, agencies, and small businesses create professional invoices and quotations, track payments, manage customers, export PDFs, and manage billing even when offline."
